notes:
The theme's settings screens no longer run past the side of the window.

### For site administrators
- The CF7 Entries screens (the list and one entry), and Updates, Global
  Options, Security and Cache & Performance, stay inside the window at
  every width. On 2.6.5 one entry ran past the right edge, so the "Mail
  failed" badge and the Form id were cut off, and the other screens did
  the same on a narrower window or a phone.
- Long addresses and words wrap instead of widening the page: a page
  address, a message with a very long word, and the field previews in the
  list, which may break inside an email address on a phone-width screen
  rather than hide the status.

### Changed
- `src/admin.css`: `box-sizing: border-box` for `:where(.ck-settings)` and
  every box under it, as Preflight would set it (the admin stylesheet has
  none). Without it a `w-full` wrapper with `px-10` was 80px wider than its
  panel. Written with `:where()`, so any utility still wins.
- The components whose size the rule would have changed keep their outer
  size: the page wrapper of Updates, Global Options, Security and Cache is
  `max-w-[69rem]` (the old 64rem plus its padding), the red mail-failed
  notice `max-w-[calc(48rem+42px)]`, the two padded lists on Updates
  `max-w-[calc(48rem+1.25rem)]`, and the list's checkbox column `w-18`.
  Toggles, the four button kinds, badges, selects and inputs measured the
  same before and after in wp-admin at 1920, 1280 and 782px.
- Wrapping: the entry's Fields grid uses `minmax(0,1fr)` for its values;
  field names and values, `ui.data_row` and the list previews are
  `min-w-0` with `overflow-wrap: anywhere`.
- A new admin screen test in `npm run test:nav`:
  `tests/js/admin-screens.test.mjs` loads the CF7 entry view (a
  283-character URL, a 200-character word) and Global Options, rendered
  from the real templates by `AdminScreenFixturesTest` into
  `tests/js/fixtures/admin-*.html`, with the admin stylesheet built from
  `src/admin.css` (`tests/js/harness.mjs` gains an `admin` option). It
  fails when anything passes the panel at 782 or 1920px, or when a toggle
  leaves 52x28 with its knob at 3px (off) and 26px (on).
- `docs/admin-screens.md`, `docs/commands.md`.

### Upgrade notes
- Nothing to do on a site: the screens are the theme's own and need no
  rebuild of a child theme.
